Whitechapel is an American deathcore band from Knoxville, Tennessee, known for its heavy sound and complex guitar work.
Periphery is an American progressive metal band known for intricate guitar parts and a blend of heavy and melodic sounds.
Ween is an American band known for its eclectic mix of rock styles, playful lyrics, and experimental recordings.
Primus is an American rock band known for its distinctive bass-driven sound and offbeat songs.
Trivium is an American heavy metal band from Florida that combines thrash metal, metalcore, and melodic elements.
Hootie and the Blowfish is an American rock band known for its melodic sound and hits from the 1990s.
Korn is an American band widely associated with the development of nu metal, with a heavy sound and emotionally direct lyrics.
Three Days Grace is a Canadian rock band known for its hard-hitting sound and emotionally charged songs.
Alice in Chains is an American rock band from Seattle known for its dark sound and layered vocal harmonies.
Staind is an American rock band known for combining heavy guitars with introspective lyrics.
Shinedown is an American rock band known for its powerful vocals and arena-ready songs.
Alter Bridge is an American rock band known for its heavy guitar sound and melodic vocals.
